symbols.name: gate weight
symbols.meaning: The fixed scalar in $F$ by which a pointwise linear gate multiplies its $s$-th input array.
symbols.quote: The scalars $\upsilon_1,\dots,\upsilon_t$ are the fixed weights of the gate, elements of $F$.

symbols.name: sink index
symbols.meaning: The index of the sink vertex on a route, which counts the number of edges on the route.
symbols.quote: Here $\mathrm{last}$ is the index of the sink, which equals the number of edges on the route.

relations.quote: A logical array is an instance of an [Array](array.md) indexed by a common address set.
The logical array of a role is carried by the [Linear networks and frames](linear-network-frames.md) at that role.
